newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse closes steady in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse closes steady in active trade.

text.p: The Ghana bourse recorded one of its active sessions this year on Monday on the last trading day before Christmas, although the index ended little changed.
The GSE All-Share-Index was off 0.08 points at 361.98 points. Offers totaled 2,492,220 shares against bids of 1,488,720 shares, with 1,314,020 changing hands.
Three equities advanced and one declined. Conglomerate CFAO gained one cedi to 22 cedis, Fan Milk Ltd added three cedis to 404 while trading group PTC gained two cedis to 133.
Standard Chartered Bank lost 100 cedis to 5,000 cedis.
